name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-12-06.219.26) introduced by Victorian Senator [Sarah Henderson](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/sarah_henderson) (Liberal), which means they failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 15, page 6 (line 24), omit “currency;”, substitute “currency.”.* > > *(2) Schedule 1, item 15, page 6 (lines 25 and 26), omit paragraph 15C(4A)(d).* ### What is paragraph 15C(4A)? According to the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2324a/24bd021): > *The payment methods specified in proposed subsection 15C(4A) are a credit card, an account, service or facility in which payment is made from a linked credit card (primarily digital wallets), digital currency (or cryptocurrency), or a method determined by the Minister by disallowable legislative instrument. The allowance for Ministerial discretion is to account for any possible new forms of credit developed to circumvent the new restrictions.*
